note: Reproducible run of the REAL CacheCore pipeline against real Postgres+pgvector and Redis (Testcontainers), using a deterministic bag-of-words MockProvider so it is $0 and deterministic. Reproduce with: npx tsx bench/run.ts (threshold via SEMANTIC_THRESHOLD). The same pipeline runs against live Gemini when GEMINI_API_KEY is set. Mock embeddings capture lexical overlap, not full semantics, so the threshold that surfaces semantic hits with the mock (~0.7) is lower than the production default (0.92) tuned for a real embedding model.
machine: single dev machine, Docker Desktop, Postgres pgvector:pg16 + redis:7

runs.workload: 85% paraphrased intents (5 intents x 4 phrasings) + 15% unique

runs.note: At 0.9 with the lexical mock, paraphrases with low word-overlap fall below threshold so only exact repeats hit. Demonstrates the threshold/precision trade-off the README discusses.
